name: Upsilon-class command shuttle
description: An Upsilon-class command shuttle, also referred to simply as an Upsilon-class shuttle or a First Order Command Shuttle, was a multi-purpose transport utilized by the First Order as an armored shuttle for high-class dignitaries and top-ranking military officials. Armed with twin heavy laser cannons and advanced sensor suites, the Upsilon-class shuttle was able to monitor and scan enemy communications to effectively avoid hostile encounters. Inspired by decades of Imperial shuttle design, it mimicked the Lambda-class T-4a shuttle, and was upgraded with powerful technologies resulting from the acquisition of chief scientists following the collapse of the Old Empire.

data.name: Upsilon-class command shuttle
data.armament: 2 SJFS L-s10.2 twin heavy laser cannons
